cohort: Women with intractable postpartum hemorrhage not responding to uterotonic agents at Khyber Teaching Hospital Peshawar between June 2007 and June 2009 with primary PPH due to uterine atony.
finding: B-lynch brace suture was effective in controlling PPH in 10 out of 12 patients, with one patient requiring additional uterine artery ligation and one requiring a subtotal hysterectomy.
